goal: After transferring the Homebrew tap from NoahNxT to NxT-Solutions, point Bronze install and publish docs at the org tap so the package is not advertised on the personal account.
outcome: README tells people to brew tap NxT-Solutions/nxt-solutions-packages. CONTRIBUTING and publish-homebrew.yml clone NxT-Solutions/homebrew-nxt-solutions-packages and still write Casks/bronze.rb. Planning-checks assert the org tap. PACKAGES_REPO_TOKEN still publishes the cask. No Formula/bronze.rb. Do not start QUEUE-ATTACHMENTS. ADR-002, ADR-009, ADR-018, and ADR-023 stay Proposed.

requirements.statement: Bronze no longer tells people to brew tap NoahNxT/nxt-solutions-packages. The published tap is NxT-Solutions/nxt-solutions-packages, which clones github.com/NxT-Solutions/homebrew-nxt-solutions-packages.
publish-homebrew.yml clones and pushes NxT-Solutions/homebrew-nxt-solutions-packages and writes Casks/bronze.rb, not Formula/bronze.rb.
Do not start QUEUE-ATTACHMENTS. Do not claim WCAG, VoiceOver, or notarization. Do not silently accept ADR-002, ADR-009, ADR-018, or ADR-023.
README contains brew tap NxT-Solutions/nxt-solutions-packages and does not tell people to tap NoahNxT/nxt-solutions-packages.
